steps.tap: 参与模型 1 · 思考等级

steps.eval: (() => {if(document.querySelectorAll('fieldset').length!==3)throw new Error('minimum roster mismatch');if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label^="移除参与模型"]'))throw new Error('can remove below two');[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='保存模型配置').click();})()

(() => {if(!document.body.innerText.includes('已保存'))throw new Error('save did not finish');if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 思考等级"]').textContent!=='高'||document.querySelector('button[aria-label="参与模型 1 · 思考等级"]').textContent!=='低')throw new Error('same-model thinking collapsed');})()

(() => {if(document.querySelectorAll('fieldset').length!==6)throw new Error('maximum roster mismatch');if(![...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='添加参与模型').disabled)throw new Error('can add beyond five');if(![...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='保存模型配置').disabled)throw new Error('empty models can save');document.querySelector('[role=switch][aria-label="启用 Fusion"]').click();})()

(() => {if([...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].some(b=>b.textContent.includes('/fusion')))throw new Error('disabled slash still visible');return 'independent thinking; 2–5 bounds; required models; disabled slash hidden';})()
(() => {if(!document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 模型"]'))throw new Error('remote settings unavailable');return 'remote settings use the same form';})()

(() => {const trigger=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 模型"]');if(!trigger.textContent.includes('FutureOS/DeepSeek Flash'))throw new Error('wrong model display');const label=document.querySelector('label[for="'+trigger.id+'"]');const gap=trigger.getBoundingClientRect().top-label.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;if(Math.abs(gap-6)>1)throw new Error('unexpected label gap: '+gap);})()

(() => {const panel=[...document.querySelectorAll('.shadow-panel')].find(el=>getComputedStyle(el).position==='fixed');if(!panel)throw new Error('missing shared menu');const rect=panel.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.top<0||rect.bottom>innerHeight)throw new Error('menu outside viewport');const row=panel.querySelector('button > span');if(row.children.length!==2||row.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().bottom>row.children[1].getBoundingClientRect().top)throw new Error('model and provider are not separate lines');if(row.children[1].textContent!=='FutureOS')throw new Error('missing provider name');if(!panel.querySelector('svg'))throw new Error('missing selected mark');})()

(() => {if(!document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'))throw new Error('Escape closed settings');if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 模型"]').getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='false')throw new Error('Escape did not close picker');return 'field spacing, provider/model labels, selection and Escape passed';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('select[aria-label="主模型 · 思考等级"]'))throw new Error('native thinking select remains');const panel=[...document.querySelectorAll('.shadow-panel')].find(el=>getComputedStyle(el).position==='fixed');if(!panel||!panel.querySelector('svg'))throw new Error('missing custom thinking menu or selected check');})()

(() => {const trigger=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 思考等级"]');if(trigger.textContent!=='高'||trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='false')throw new Error('thinking selection failed');trigger.click();})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="主模型 · 思考等级"]').getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='false')throw new Error('both menus open');return 'two-line model rows, custom thinking, selection and coordinated menus passed';})()

(() => {if(!document.body.innerText.includes('已保存'))throw new Error('save failed');if(!document.querySelector('[aria-label="主模型 · 思考等级"]').textContent.includes('高')||!document.querySelector('[aria-label="参与模型 1 · 思考等级"]').textContent.includes('低'))throw new Error('thinking overwritten');if(document.querySelector('[aria-label^="移除参与模型"]'))throw new Error('can remove below two');})()

(() => {if(document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label$=" · 模型"]').length!==6)throw new Error('five roles not shown');if(document.querySelector('[aria-label="添加参与模型"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')!=='true')throw new Error('can add sixth');if(document.querySelector('[aria-label="保存模型配置"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')!=='true')throw new Error('can save empty role');document.querySelector('[role=switch][aria-label="启用 Fusion"]').click();})()
(() => {if(document.querySelector('[role=switch][aria-label="启用 Fusion"]').checked!==false)throw new Error('disable failed');return 'mobile independent levels, save, counts and switch passed';})()
